summary: The StudentPrerequisites class manages student prerequisite data, including updates to health and safety records.
purpose: To maintain and update prerequisite information for students, particularly related to health and safety compliance.

workflows.name: Health and Safety Update
steps: Search for prerequisites of a student.
Update the prerequisite records using stored procedures.

validations: Check for validity of dates and mandatory fields.
conditions: Expiry dates must be set if years are specified.
dependencies: Database for accessing and updating prerequisite records.
